name: Can I renovate an existing landscape without a full redesign?

mainEntity.name: Can I renovate an existing landscape without a full redesign?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, you can renovate an existing landscape without undertaking a complete redesign. This often involves targeted updates such as refreshing planting beds, upgrading irrigation systems for efficiency, adding new outdoor lighting, or enhancing specific features like a fire pit or outdoor kitchen. A landscape designer can assess your current space, identify areas for improvement, and develop a plan to revitalize your outdoor environment while retaining desirable existing elements.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, targeted renovations like updating planting, irrigation, or lighting can refresh an existing landscape without a full redesign.
